exam_scheme.note: JEE (Main) Paper 1 is conducted in Computer Based Test (CBT) mode by the National Testing Agency (NTA) for admission to undergraduate engineering programs (B.E./B.Tech.) at NITs, IIITs, CFTIs, and participating State institutions, and serves as the screening eligibility test for JEE (Advanced). The examination is conducted in two sessions annually (January and April) in 13 languages. Merit ranking is based on normalized NTA percentile scores, merging both sessions for candidates appearing in both and taking the best of the two scores.
